memory_transport: local stdio MCP child with one isolated store per trial
model_endpoint: plain HTTP numeric loopback only; TLS, DNS names, redirects and ambient proxies are disabled
tool_execution: only preregistered public MCP tools exposed for the current phase
operator_import: evaluator-owned bounded CLI invocation before candidate agent access
credentials: optional bearer token read from process environment; never written to artifacts or logs
trace_content: hashes, normalized tool names, usage and closed error classes only
provider_boundary: the adapter restricts its own network destination; the model service must be independently verified as local
